features.title: Everything you need to turn TVs into powerful sales tools
features.subtitle: No complicated network setups. No expensive hardware. Just clear, reliable tools that save you hours every week.
features.f1Desc: Launch the app on your TV, enter the 6-digit code shown on screen into your dashboard, and start broadcasting in seconds.
features.f2Desc: Control 1 TV or 100 screens across multiple cities from your laptop or smartphone without ever visiting the location physically.
features.f3Desc: Upload high-resolution images, flyers, and 4K videos. Organize slides, set custom durations, and create smooth playback loops.
features.f4Desc: Automatically switch from breakfast menus in the morning to lunch specials and evening promotions based on your exact timetable.
features.f5Desc: Display multiple pieces of content on a single TV. Support for fullscreen or up to 4 simultaneous zones (video, menu, ticker, clock).
features.f6Desc: All content is safely stored in local device memory. If the internet goes down, your screens keep playing without any black screen.

howItWorks.title: From unboxing to live broadcast in 4 minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: You don't need an IT technician. Any team member can connect a TV and publish content in four intuitive steps.
howItWorks.s1Title: Open the App on Your TV
howItWorks.s1Desc: Install ABSignage on your Android TV, Smart TV, or TV Box. A unique 6-digit pairing code will appear on the screen.
howItWorks.s2Desc: Log into your ABSignage account from any browser, type the 6-digit code, and assign your screen a location name.
howItWorks.s3Desc: Upload your pictures and videos. Choose fullscreen playback or split your screen into up to 4 dynamic zones.
howItWorks.s4Desc: Hit publish. Your content streams instantly to the screen and continues playing smoothly around the clock.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before starting
faq.subtitle: Have questions about hardware, setup, or features? Here are clear answers.
faq.q1: How does pairing a TV screen work?
faq.a1: Install the ABSignage app on your TV or Android Box. When you open it, a 6-digit pairing code appears on screen. Open your ABSignage web dashboard on your computer or phone, enter the code, and your TV is instantly connected.
faq.q2: What happens if the internet connection is lost?
faq.a2: Your TVs never go black. All videos, images, and playlists are cached locally in the device's storage. Even if the internet disconnects for days, the TV continues playing seamlessly. When connectivity returns, it automatically syncs any updates.
faq.q3: Do I need to buy expensive commercial screens?
faq.a3: No. ABSignage works on standard Android TVs, Google TVs, and any normal TV equipped with an affordable Android TV Box or HDMI Stick (costing around $30). You can use your existing televisions without replacing them.
faq.q4: How does split-screen and multi-zone support work?
faq.a4: In your playlist manager, you can select whether a slide plays in fullscreen or in a multi-zone layout. You can divide your screen into up to 4 zones (e.g. video on the left, price menu on the right, scrolling ticker at the bottom, and clock/logo).
faq.q5: Can I manage screens in different branches or cities?
faq.a5: Yes. The dashboard is 100% cloud-based. You can group screens by city, store, or room, and push updates to one screen, a selected group, or all screens simultaneously with a single click.
faq.q6: Can I try ABSignage before subscribing?
faq.a6: Yes. We offer a full 14-day free trial so you can connect your screens, test your playlists, and experience the platform with zero risk and no credit card required.
